title: Hodgeson House, Christian St
text:
Hello,

We're very interested in Hodgeson House, Christian Street and would love to arrange a viewing. My partner Grisha and I are moving to London in mid-November 2026 for a long-term let. I work at Synthesia in Regent's Place.

We have a well-behaved dog and a cat, and we're happy to discuss a pet deposit or any references you need.

Could you confirm the floor area and the earliest move-in date? Video viewings would also work for us.

Thank you,
Maria Surkova
+34 605 227 263
